records.source: Lost some items, huh? I can recover one of them, for a fee. Choose wisely.
records.translation: May mga nawala kang bagay, ano? Mababalik ko ang isa kapalit ng bayad. Pumili nang mabuti.

records.source: A Void Ghost pendant! How did you...?$3#$b#Oh, wow.$7#$b#@... yes, I'll come live with you, if you like. But we have to keep it secret from everyone.#$b#I'll be at your house in a few days... okay?$h
records.translation: Isang Palawit ng Multo ng Kawalan! Paano mo...?$3#$b#O, grabe.$7#$b#@... oo, titira ako kasama mo, kung gusto mo. Pero kailangan nating ilihim ito sa lahat.#$b#Darating ako sa bahay mo pagkalipas ng ilang araw... ayos?$h

records.source: Good morning, @... I snuck in during the night.$l#$b#It'll take me a while to get used to this new life... This is very different from the sewers...
records.translation: Magandang umaga, @... Palihim akong pumasok kagabi.$l#$b#Matatagalan bago ako masanay sa bagong buhay na ito... Ibang-iba ito sa mga Imburnal...

records.source: You can't propose to someone while living with a housemate.
records.translation: Hindi ka maaaring mag-alok ng kasal habang may kasama ka sa bahay.

records.source: I'm away. Please leave your payment in the box. -Krobus
records.translation: Wala ako. Pakiiwan ang bayad sa kahon. -Krobus

records.source: Get your movie tickets right here! Give one to a friend to invite them to the show!
records.translation: Dito na kayo kumuha ng mga tiket sa pelikula! Bigyan ang kaibigan ng isa upang anyayahan siyang manood!
